competences.description: Attacks the enemy to steal all beneficial effects granted on the enemy with a 50% chance. If the enemy has no beneficial effects after attacking, additionally uses [Mace of Conviction] on another random enemy. This effect can be activated up to 3 times.
Attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 2 turns.

Grants 2 of the following effects on all allies for 2 turn each at the start of the boss' turn: Immunity, Increase Defense, Increase Attack Power, Increase Attack Speed, Increase Critical Resistance, and HP Recovery. [Automatic Effect]
Decreases the target's Attack Bar by 10% each based on the number of beneficial effects when attacking. [Automatic Effect]
